chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from Yaʿqūb al-Aḥmar, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

The woman in nifās, when she is tried with many days, remains for the like of her usual days during which she used to refrain before that, and she adds precaution by the like of the days of her mother to her days. Then she performs ghusl, inserts cotton, and acts as the mustaḥāḍah acts. And if she does not know the days of her nifās and is tried with that, she remains for the like of the days of her mother, or her sister, or her maternal aunt, and adds precaution by two-thirds of that. Then she acts as the mustaḥāḍah acts: she inserts cotton and performs ghusl.

key_terms.أَيَّامِ نِفَاسِهَا: the days of her postnatal bleeding period
key_terms.ابْتُلِيَتْ: she was afflicted or tried with an extended condition
key_terms.الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ: a woman experiencing istiḥāḍah, irregular non-menstrual bleeding
key_terms.اَلنُّفَسَاءُ: a woman in the state of postnatal bleeding
key_terms.اِسْتَظْهَرَتْ: she added precautionary extra days before changing the ruling
key_terms.تَحْتَشِي: she inserts cotton or padding to manage the bleeding
key_terms.تَغْتَسِلُ: she performs ghusl, the ritual bath

ai.seo_question: How should a woman determine the duration of nifās if postnatal bleeding continues for many days?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman experiencing prolonged nifās. It explains how she estimates the period of nifās based on her own prior pattern, or otherwise by comparison with female relatives, after which she performs ghusl and follows the rulings of istiḥāḍah.
